decisions.reason: As a floor-care consumable closely tied to the firm's wood flooring business and upgraded to its own page in 2024, it looks like a product the firm is actively supporting.

Maintenance oil fits the installed base of wooden floors and supports after-sales business, though its weaker website prominence suggests slightly higher discontinuation risk than the lead care items.
A dedicated 2024 product page indicates commitment, and a care product for oiled wood floors is a natural complement for a wood-focused manufacturer serving repeat maintenance needs.
Moisture-protection underlay is a practical accessory that helps complete flooring sales, but as a supporting item with only basic website mention it is somewhat easier to rationalize away.
High-density underlay foam complements floor installations, yet it is more of a standard accessory and therefore more exposed to assortment cleanup if sales are modest.
Oak parquet is strongly aligned with the firm's core wood-products activity and with stable demand for classic flooring types in Germany, making withdrawal relatively unlikely.
